queries:
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS w
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS a FROM country_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT country, avg_wins
  FROM country_avg
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT a FROM overall)
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM above
)
SELECT country,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - (SELECT a FROM overall) AS above_overall_avg,
       avg_wins - (SELECT g FROM grp) AS above_group_avg
FROM above
WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT g FROM grp)
ORDER BY avg_wins DESC;
WITH race_wins AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, SUM(ds.wins) AS w
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_wins
  GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT country, avg_wins
  FROM country_avg
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall)
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS above_overall_avg,
       a.avg_wins - (SELECT group_avg FROM grp) AS above_group_avg
FROM above a
WHERE a.avg_wins > (SELECT group_avg FROM grp)
ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC;
WITH race_fig AS (
  SELECT ds.raceId, MAX(ds.wins) AS w
  FROM driverStandings ds
  GROUP BY ds.raceId
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(rf.w) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_fig rf
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = rf.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, o.overall_avg
  FROM country_avg ca, overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg
FROM above a, grp g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg;
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN results res ON res.raceId = ds.raceId AND res.driverId = ds.driverId
  WHERE ds.wins >= 1 OR res.time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg ca, overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg
FROM above a, overall o, grp g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg
ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC;
